messages.content: The PNW loop is put away, so I want to start the Texas swing. Mid-September: Sunday travel from SLC, Monday North Dallas school visits, Monday evening fair in Richardson, Tuesday Fort Worth counselor breakfast, Wednesday Austin school appointments, and Thursday evening San Antonio college night. I’m stuck on open-jaw versus round-trip Dallas, plus hotel bases. I can leave Sunday after lunch, and I’d like to avoid heroic drives after a fair.

Yes. Before I recommend holds, two timing bits matter: what time does the Richardson fair likely release you Monday, and do you need to be back in Salt Lake by any particular time Friday? Also are one-way rental fees reimbursable if the route saves a long backtrack?

Richardson is listed 6:00-8:30 for now. Fort Worth breakfast is 7:30-ish Tuesday. Austin first visit Wednesday should be around 8:30, and San Antonio college night Thursday is 6:00-8:30. Friday I just need to get home at a reasonable hour. Finance will question a one-way car fee but reimburse it if the logic is clear. If Delta is close, include it, but I’m fine with American or Southwest if the schedule is better.

Then I’d frame it this way: option 1, fly into Dallas and home from San Antonio: least backtracking, one-way car, return likely one connection. Option 2, fly into Dallas and home from Austin: sometimes cheaper, but adds a northbound drive after San Antonio or Friday morning. Option 3, Dallas round-trip: may price well, but forces a 4+ hour backtrack. My starting recommendation is option 1 unless the one-way car fee is extreme.
What about starting in Austin on Sunday and driving north? Austin has better flight choices than San Antonio.

I wouldn’t lead with that. Austin-to-North Dallas on Sunday evening is a long wrong-way drive before an 8-ish Monday start, and any flight delay turns into a late hotel arrival plus an early morning. Dallas inbound keeps Monday protected. Between DFW and Love Field, choose the airport that gives the better fare/timing and easiest car pickup; DFW usually makes the one-way rental simpler.

Okay. For the first hotel, I need Monday morning to be painless, and I need somewhere I can still get food after the Richardson fair. Breakfast at the hotel is helpful, but Tuesday has that counselor breakfast.

Use Richardson or Plano for Sunday and Monday. The US-75/George Bush corridor keeps you close to North Dallas schools and the Richardson fair, with late-ish casual food in Richardson/Plano. Addison is workable but adds cross-town driving; downtown Dallas is the wrong base. For Tuesday morning, hotel breakfast may not matter if you’re leaving before 6:00 for Fort Worth, so I’d treat it as useful for Monday only and plan a coffee/protein backup for the car.
Would you move hotels Monday night to Fort Worth after the fair?

Only if that breakfast becomes earlier than listed. After an 8:30 fair, you still have load-out, dinner, and a 50-65 minute drive. A Fort Worth hotel gets you a calmer Tuesday morning, but it creates a late Monday check-in and another unpack/repack. Staying two nights in Richardson means a very early Tuesday departure, but it is simpler and avoids driving tired right after the fair.
Let’s keep the two nights in Richardson for now and flag Fort Worth as a backup if the breakfast time shifts earlier.

Good. The road sequence would be: Sunday arrive Dallas and sleep Richardson/Plano; Monday North Dallas plus Richardson fair; Tuesday leave early for Fort Worth, then drive south after the breakfast/lunch block; Tuesday night Austin; Wednesday Austin schools, then continue to San Antonio; Wednesday and Thursday nights San Antonio.
Hotel areas for Austin and San Antonio?

For Austin, I’d look north/Domain/Arboretum if your Wednesday schools are north or central; it avoids downtown parking and still has easy dinner choices. Use downtown only if the appointments are there. For San Antonio, because the college night is on the north side, airport/North Star or north-central near 410 is more practical than the River Walk. I’d still verify parking cost and breakfast start time, and make sure there are restaurants within a short drive for Thursday after the event.
The Austin list is north and central. San Antonio is near 410, not tourist time. Practical is exactly right.

Then the hotel shortlist is: 1) Richardson/Plano, Sunday-Monday, breakfast listed by 6:30 and parking clear, with a dinner backup after the fair. 2) Austin North/Arboretum or Domain, Tuesday only, free or clearly priced parking, and easy dinner nearby. 3) San Antonio Airport/North Star or north-central 410, Wednesday-Thursday, breakfast at 6:00 or 6:30, parking shown, and restaurants open late enough after Thursday load-out.
For flights, which holds would you put in tonight?

I’d hold three things: Sunday afternoon SLC to DFW/DAL arriving early evening, prioritizing nonstop or clean schedule over a small fare difference; Friday San Antonio-to-SLC in the early afternoon with one comfortable connection; and one backup Friday Austin-to-SLC option only as a price check. I would not hold the Dallas round-trip unless finance specifically asks to see the comparison, because the backtrack is the weak point.
Would you actually keep the Austin return alive?

Yes, but only as a temporary comparison. It is useful if it is dramatically cheaper or has a much better schedule. The hidden cost is the Thursday-night or Friday-morning drive from San Antonio back to Austin, plus possibly returning the car at a different airport than the event city. If the savings are modest, San Antonio return is the cleaner choice.
Car plan? I know one-way rentals can look fine until the taxes and drop fee show up.

Place a cancellable one-way hold for Dallas pickup Sunday around 4:30-5:00 p.m. and San Antonio return Friday late morning. Check the total for drop fee, taxes, unlimited mileage, toll policy, and whether pickup airport changes the rate. Use the same hold to compare DFW versus Love Field only if the flight options are close; otherwise keep the simplest airport.
Give me the action list I can send finance with the why-not-Dallas-round-trip explanation.

Action list: hold Sunday afternoon SLC-Dallas, clean/nonstop schedule; hold Friday early-afternoon SAT-SLC with one comfortable connection; keep an Austin-return hold only long enough to compare; price Dallas round-trip only as benchmark. Hold one-way car Dallas-San Antonio with all fees visible. Hotels: Richardson/Plano 2 nights, Austin North/Arboretum or Domain 1 night, San Antonio Airport/North Star or north-central 410 2 nights. Meal notes: Monday late dinner Richardson/Plano, Tuesday car breakfast before Fort Worth, Tuesday dinner north Austin, Thursday late-dinner backup near 410. Finance rationale: open-jaw avoids the San Antonio-to-Dallas backtrack, protects the Thursday evening event, and reduces fatigue before Friday return.

messages.content: Texas update before I book hotels: Richardson fair now ends at 8:45 p.m., Fort Worth counselor breakfast check-in is 7:15 a.m., and one Austin school can only do first thing Wednesday. Can you rebuild the route? I’m especially unsure about Tuesday night.

With those times, I would not drive all the way to Austin Monday after Richardson. The cleaner structure is still Richardson Sunday-Monday, Fort Worth early Tuesday, then Austin Tuesday night. Before I lock that in: after the Fort Worth breakfast, do you have any Tuesday afternoon visits in North Texas, or can you leave for Austin soon after?
I have one counselor lunch near TCU at noon and should be done by 1:30 or 2:00. No evening Tuesday event.

That helps. Day by day: Monday, stay Richardson after the fair and keep dinner simple. Tuesday, leave Richardson around 5:35-5:45 for Fort Worth, check in at 7:15, do the lunch, then depart about 2:00. That puts you into north Austin roughly dinner time if traffic behaves. Wednesday, sleep near the Austin appointment and leave the hotel around 7:15 for a 7:45 check-in.
Can you compare Austin versus Waco or Temple for Tuesday overnight? I’m tempted by the shorter Tuesday drive.

Tuesday overnight comparison: Austin North/Arboretum has the longest Tuesday drive, but gives the best Wednesday reliability and normal dinner choices. Temple is easier Tuesday, but still leaves an early Wednesday and less margin if I-35 is messy. Waco is the easiest Tuesday, but worst for Wednesday because you are counting on a long morning drive before the school. For an 8:00-ish Austin visit, Austin North is the one I’d keep.

Okay. Return airport is the other question. San Antonio has a Friday flight with one connection that works. Austin is about $140 cheaper, but only if I drive back north after the Thursday evening event or very early Friday.

I’d be cautious about chasing $140 there. A Thursday college night ending around 8:45 means load-out could push you past 9:15, then you still have the San Antonio-to-Austin drive and a late hotel arrival. Friday morning is possible, but it spends your buffer on the highway before a flight. San Antonio costs more but matches the event city and lowers the miss-the-flight risk.
Load-out is likely 20-30 minutes. The event is north side San Antonio, so an airport/North Star hotel would be easy.

Then I’d return from San Antonio. Keep the car through Thursday night, stay north/airport area, fuel before the airport loop Friday, and set the car return for about 10:45 or 11:00 if the flight is early afternoon. Operationally, aim to return it closer to 10:15 so a gas stop or rental line doesn’t eat the buffer.
Where are the breakfast gaps now?

Tuesday is the main gap: Richardson breakfast may open too late for a 5:35 departure, and the Fort Worth event may not serve enough, so carry breakfast. Wednesday at an Austin North hotel should work only if breakfast starts by 6:30 and you leave by 7:15. Thursday and Friday are easier if the San Antonio hotel starts at 6:00, but Friday breakfast cannot push the car-return target.
Late dinners?

Monday: plan a quick Richardson/Plano option or pickup before the fair if dinner service will be thin after 9:00. Tuesday: north Austin/Domain is fine. Wednesday: San Antonio airport or North Star has practical choices. Thursday: assume you may be tired after load-out and save one restaurant that is open until at least 10:00, plus a backup convenience-store meal.
So the hotel sequence stays two Richardson, one Austin North, two San Antonio airport/North Star?
Yes. I’d only change Monday to Fort Worth if that counselor breakfast moves earlier than 7:15. Otherwise the fewer hotel changes are worth the early Tuesday alarm.
What do I need to change from the earlier holds?

Change list: drop the Dallas round-trip as the working plan; keep Dallas inbound and make San Antonio the primary return; keep Austin return only until finance sees the comparison, then release it if the savings stay modest. Set the one-way car as Dallas pickup and San Antonio return. For hotels, keep Richardson Sunday-Monday, choose Austin North/Arboretum over Waco/Temple for Tuesday, and hold San Antonio airport/North Star for Wednesday-Thursday. Add calendar notes: no dependable hotel breakfast Tuesday, protect the Wednesday 7:45 Austin arrival, and do not let Friday breakfast delay fuel and car return.

messages.content: I’m ready to turn Texas holds into reservations. The plan is Sunday afternoon SLC to Dallas, one-way car DFW to San Antonio, and Friday early-afternoon SAT to SLC with one connection. Hotels are Richardson Sunday/Monday, Austin Tuesday, San Antonio airport area Wednesday/Thursday. What order should I book, and does Tuesday still protect the Wednesday school?

Yes if the Austin hotel is north enough. Before you click, check the exact Tuesday hotel against the first Wednesday school: if it is within about 20 minutes in normal morning traffic, it’s safer than Waco/Temple. What are the hotel area and Wednesday check-in time?

First Austin school is near 183 and MoPac. They want me there at 7:45 for an 8:00 start. The Austin hold is Arboretum area, free parking, breakfast starts 6:30, queen room. Domain option has more restaurants but charges $22 for parking.

Take the Arboretum hold. It keeps Wednesday realistic: breakfast right at 6:30 if you want it, back upstairs quickly, and depart about 7:10-7:15. The Domain dinner scene is nicer, but $22 parking for one night is not worth it unless the room rate is lower by more than that.

Flight choices: Delta Sunday 2:10 to DFW is $36 more than American 1:40. Return from SAT has Delta at 12:55 with a 78-minute Atlanta connection, or American at 1:20 through DFW with a 42-minute connection. I don't want a sprint.

Book the Delta return. The 78-minute connection is much more comfortable than 42 minutes through DFW, especially with a work trip’s materials and no room for a misconnect. For the outbound, the Delta nonstop is also fine if the $36 difference is acceptable; the schedule is close enough that reliability and seat choice can break the tie.
$36 and $52 are acceptable. Please request window seats if they’re open.
Noted: Delta both ways, window seats selected if available during booking, and recheck the seat map after ticketing in case the assignment does not stick.
Car: DFW pickup Sunday 4:20 p.m., SAT return Friday 10:45 a.m. The quote shows the one-way fee included. Midsize is cheapest, compact SUV is $9/day more. I’ll have display boxes and banners.

Choose the compact SUV for the cargo room. Confirm the final total shows taxes, concession fees, the one-way/drop charge, unlimited mileage, and the toll policy. Keep the reservation return time at 10:45, but aim to be at the rental return closer to 10:15 after fueling.

Hotels: Richardson breakfast 6:00, free parking, queen room, cancel Sept. 13 by 6 p.m. Austin Arboretum breakfast 6:30, free parking, cancel Sept. 16 by 6 p.m. San Antonio airport breakfast 6:00, free parking, restaurants within a short drive, cancel Sept. 17 by 11:59 p.m. Anything off?

That sequence works. The only weak spots are Tuesday morning breakfast from Richardson, which you’ll probably skip for the Fort Worth check-in, and Wednesday breakfast in Austin, which is possible but tight. For San Antonio, make sure the free parking appears on the confirmation, not just the search result.
Rooms around San Antonio are disappearing because of the college night. Should I book that before the flights?

Yes, if it is refundable and there’s no prepay penalty, grab the San Antonio room first so you don’t lose the base. Then ticket flights, book the car, and finish Austin and Richardson. If the San Antonio room requires prepayment, pause and ticket the flights first so the trip dates are locked before you commit.
Give me the final booking note I can paste into the file, including receipt reminders.

Texas recruitment swing booking note: Flights: Delta SLC-DFW Sunday 2:10 p.m.; Delta SAT-SLC Friday 12:55 p.m. with a 78-minute Atlanta connection. Window seats selected/requested; recheck after ticketing and at check-in. Car: compact SUV, DFW pickup Sunday 4:20 p.m., SAT return Friday 10:45 a.m.; one-way fee included in quote; target actual return by 10:15 after fueling. Hotels: Richardson Sunday-Monday, queen room, breakfast 6:00, free parking, cancel by Sept. 13 at 6 p.m.; Austin Arboretum Tuesday, queen room, breakfast 6:30, free parking, cancel by Sept. 16 at 6 p.m.; San Antonio airport area Wednesday-Thursday, queen room, breakfast 6:00, free parking, restaurants nearby, cancel by Sept. 17 at 11:59 p.m. Logistics: carry breakfast Tuesday, keep Wednesday departure from Austin hotel around 7:10-7:15, save Thursday late-dinner backup near North Star/airport. Receipts: airfare, baggage/seat if any, car contract, final rental receipt, fuel, tolls, parking if charged, and final hotel folios showing nightly rate and taxes.
